row: Boehringer Ingelheim is a global leader in equine health, offering a comprehensive portfolio of solutions for the well-being of horses. As a family-owned business with 140 years of history, we continue to invest in research and innovation to advance equine health so those who care for horses have all they need to take charge, make well-informed decisions and lead with care.
